framing.verdict: The implementation establishes useful pre-v1 contracts and fail-closed boundaries, but it does not yet implement the planned canonical CAD kernel.

key_claims.claim: CADGeometry is not the canonical runtime geometry source.
The capability ledger is documentary rather than executable and does not prove API/test parity.
General Boolean, complete topology validation, stable selection, constraint solving, and exact STEP/IGES remain unimplemented or scaffold-only.
Current requirements were contracted to the implementation, underestimating the accepted goal.

residual_uncertainties: No external CAD oracle or production model corpus was evaluated.
Milestone states are ordinal judgments based on runtime-path evidence, not completion percentages.
